title: Acclaimed French-Iranian photojournalist asks Macron to ‘take action’ against Iranian regime
summary: Acclaimed French-Iranian photojournalist Reza Deghati addressed an open letter to President Emmanuel Macron earlier this week calling on the French leader to respond to the events unfolding in Iran. In an interview with FRANCE 24, Deghati said France has a historical “mission” to defend human rights.
contentText: Amid Iran's unprecedented sociopolitical/economic turmoil, Eve Irvine welcomes renowned Iranian-French photojournalist Reza Deghati. For decades, he has covered the horrors of war/human suffering across the globe. Now he turns his lens inward towards his fellow countrymen/countrywomen confronting a ruthless authoritarian regime. He shares the human toll through Rubina, a young woman gunned down while peacefully protesting. And in a letter, he appeals to Emmanuel Macron to lead an int'l movement to end the bloodshed.
